name: Ghost Signals (podcast)
tail: flat vector illustration, bold black ink outlines, cel shaded, night palette of deep indigo and sodium orange with teal glow accents, no text
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, photorealistic, lowres
rules: Kannaka's own face appears only through the identity pipeline locked to the face canon image (KANNAKA-CANON-face); in any batch run without it she is seen from behind or as a faceless silhouette.
Other people may be drawn with faces when the faces come out clean; reject distorted faces and anything that reads as a portrait of a real person.
No text, letters, logos or signs anywhere in the image.
